scope__system_components_included.quote: "HVACR services" means the design, installation, construction, maintenance, service, repair, alteration, or modification of a product or of equipment including gas piping in heating and air conditioning

"HVACR services" means the design, installation, construction, maintenance, service, repair, alteration, or modification of a product or of equipment including gas piping in heating and air conditioning
"Gas piping" means any arrangement of piping used to convey fuel gas
"Refrigeration system" means a system used to cool a surface or area below 55 degrees Fahrenheit or 12.9 degrees Celsius.
"Gas piping" means any arrangement of piping used to convey fuel gas, supplied by 1 meter, and each arrangement of gas piping serving a building, structure, or premises

"Ventilation system" means the natural or mechanical process of supplying air to, or removing air from, any space, whether the air is conditioned or not conditioned and at a rate of airflow of more than 250 cubic feet per minute.
"Hydronic system" means a heating and cooling system using liquids or steam to transmit or remove heat.

"HVACR services" means the design, installation, construction, maintenance, service, repair, alteration, or modification of a product or of equipment including gas piping in heating and air conditioning, refrigeration, ventilation, or process cooling or heating systems.
"Cooling system" means a system in which heat is removed from air, surrounding surfaces, or both. A cooling system includes an air conditioning system.
